findings.text: The test expects `report.main` to accept a snapshot with only `snapshot_files.jsonl`, although the store specification requires a row in `snapshots` before readers use it. Fix: Add the completion row to the valid fixture and make the report reject a snapshot that lacks it.

The fixture writes `decisions` by hand, so the tests pass if `build_rows` stops recording decisions or `LocalStore.write_version` omits them. Fix: Read back a file version produced by both functions and assert the stored decision for each fixture constant.

The fixture has only one file version, so the test passes if the report reads every version in the store. Fix: Add a second snapshot with a different decision for the same module and assert that each report contains only its own decision.

The hash order always selects `b`, whose text is short enough that restoring the 400-character truncation would still pass the test. Fix: Give `b` more than 400 characters and assert that its complete text appears in the sample.
The rewritten test drops the `by_kind` assertion, so removing the required candidate breakdown would still pass. Fix: Assert the expected `by_kind` counts in the printed report.
`StoredCounts.reported` promises tuples, but `json.loads` returns each name-and-cause pair as a list. Fix: Annotate the decoded pairs as lists or convert them to tuples before returning them.
`printed` inherits `Any` from `json.loads`, leaving the report fields and sample rows untyped. Fix: Give the decoded report an explicit type that covers the fields the test reads.

The status says version 5 fills the test store, but the test runs the version 6 writer with the version 5 key prefix and therefore writes the new `decisions` field. Fix: State that the fixture checks invalidation of version 5 keys using the current writer.
